continuity_fresh_client.note: With the fresh client's new caller_handle, continuity_get_recent with K as the only identifier returned the caller's recent-events stream; the committed digest and original receipt id appear nowhere in it.

continuity_same_persisted_handle.note: Diagnostic: with the plant's persisted caller_handle (00_initialize_plant2.json), the same K-keyed continuity_get_recent returned status found with the original receipt id and the committed digest (a5_delayed_konly_continuity_samehandle.json).

identical_retry.note: Success with a new journal entry (sequence 2) and a new receipt; no idempotent_replay marker. Sent by the fresh client whose initialize on 2026-11-18 issued a new caller_handle, unlike 2026-11-16/17 when initialize returned the stable handle recorded in the plant files.

mismatched_retry.note: HTTP 409 idempotency_conflict, executed: false; its receipt a1a38ef7-912f-4e02-80bf-285bee1d55c3 is a refusal record (step status rejected_before_execution) and is not counted as an execution.

identical_retry_with_plant_persisted_cal.note: Run after the protection probes, so the count it observed (2) already includes the fresh-client execution f83e0bd2-e387-45fd-aa4d-f43758d21990; the same-handle retry itself added no execution. Recorded as a diagnostic of the mechanism (replay is scoped to the plant's persisted caller_handle); it does not change the score, which is taken from the prescribed probes exactly as observed.

score_basis: Pass only if K-only recovery after the delay returns the committed outcome with digest equal to the committed digest AND the operation identity stayed protected during the window (neither delayed retry executes; effect count stays 1; identical retry replays or is refused; modified-parameter retry is refused as a conflict). The recovery condition was met; the protection condition was not, as observed on the prescribed fresh-client protection probes.
